component.name: DA Private Coder
component.summary: Claude Code on end-to-end encrypted models

description.p: Runs Claude Code, in a terminal or in VSCodium and VS Code, on NanoGPT's Private Mode models. Every request is sealed on your computer to a confidential-computing enclave whose attestation is checked first, so NanoGPT only relays it: your code, files and prompts stay between you and the enclave. Plain Claude Code keeps running as usual.

Its window sets it up (your NanoGPT key, the command, the switch for your editor), lets you choose the models and how it searches the web, checks the enclave, and shows what each request cost, never what was said.
